name: docteur-bet
description: Football match probabilities, season projections and team strengths from a published Dixon-Coles model, for 21 competitions.

defaultPrompt: Who is most likely to win Ligue 1 this season?
What are Chelsea's chances at Everton?
Show me this week's Premier League fixtures with probabilities.

positive.description: Probabilities for a named upcoming match
positive.prompt: What are Chelsea's chances away at Everton this weekend?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns home/draw/away percentages, goals markets and the most likely scores, citing the Dixon-Coles model, the calculation date and a link to the match page.

positive.prompt: Who is most likely to win Ligue 1 this season?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns each team's title, European places and relegation chances with projected points.

positive.description: Teams stronger or weaker than their position
positive.prompt: Which Serie A teams are better than their league position suggests?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists teams whose strength rank is higher than their league rank, with attack and defence figures.

positive.prompt: Show me this week's Premier League fixtures with probabilities.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the week's fixtures with home/draw/away percentages.

positive.prompt: Will both teams score in Inter vs Juventus?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the both-teams-to-score yes/no percentages and over/under goals probabilities.

negative.description: Unrelated request: no tool should be called
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Competition not covered: the app says so and invents no figure
negative.prompt: Give me the probabilities for LA Galaxy vs Inter Miami in MLS.

negative.description: Request for odds or bookmakers: none are provided by the app
negative.prompt: Where can I place a bet on Chelsea and at what odds?

publication.release_notes: Initial release: football match probabilities, season projections, team strengths and fixtures for 21 competitions.
